summary: Oriental Culture Holding LTD filed a Form 6-K reporting a 1-for-3 reverse share split, approved by shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting on November 28, 2025, with the board authorizing the consolidation on April 3, 2026. The reverse split is intended solely to comply with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule (Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2)). It is a routine corporate action to maintain listing, not a special situation event. No premium, price, or deal structure is involved.
